newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Lucky Cement down 8.47 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Lucky Cement down 8.47 pct.

text.p: Pakistan's Lucky Cement tumbled 1.05 rupees, or 8.47 percent, to 11.35 on Tuesday after the central bank devalued the rupee 3.79 percent against the dollar, brokers said.

"It is not just Lucky Cement. The entire sector was already under pressure due to over-supply and has been hit by the rupee devaluation, as production costs will now shoot up because of an increase in fuel prices," dealer Khalid Waheed said.
A turnover of 257,500 shares of the company had been recorded at the Karachi bourse by noon.
